commits.message:
fix(panel): a Panel's and a Padding's style is the ground under the whole block (rich-panel-ech)

Style reached only the padding spaces, leaving the content and the frame
unstyled. As in Rich, the style is now applied under the content, and a
Panel's frame is its border style laid over it; title, subtitle and accessory
styles lay over the frame's instead of replacing it, so they no longer cut a
hole in the background on the border rows. docs/panel.md regains its Style
section.

fix(tree): a node's style draws its row and every row beneath it (rich-tree-736) (#260)

* fix(tree): a node's style draws its row and every row beneath it (rich-tree-736)

Tree stored `style` and never read it. The walk now stacks each node's
style the way it already stacked guide styles; the label is drawn over it,
so its own markup still wins, and only its background reaches the guides,
as in Rich. docs/tree.md gets its style example back.

* fix(tree): say where a node's background reaches, show it, and pin it at depth (rich-tree-736)

Review (high): the docs claimed the whole row was filled; only the guides
and label are. The example now carries a background, and the test covers
an ancestor rail and a multi-line label's later guides.
